scope: Source-observation ledger. Entries record what public source files say; they do not certify the physical bill of materials or DarwinG60 hardware support.

claims.subject: Kernel panel configuration label
claims.finding: Archived kernel DTS includes a Tianma/ILI7807S-labelled DSI panel configuration with 1080x2460 timing and dynamic 60/120 Hz modes.

sources.detail: Panel definition filename and DTS timing/configuration.

limitations: A DTS label is not the retail LCD module SKU.
The archived community kernel may not cover every regional or board revision.

claims.subject: Kernel touchscreen device-tree binding
claims.finding: Archived kernel DTS declares compatible = tchip,ilitek on an SPI bus.

sources.detail: Touchscreen compatible string and SPI node.
Kernel driver matches the tchip,ilitek compatible string.

limitations: The compatible string identifies a driver family, not an exact controller IC part number.
The repository is an archived community kernel source.

claims.subject: Android touchscreen gesture sysfs interface
claims.finding: Android gesture configuration references an NVT-labelled touchscreen sysfs path for gesture controls.
limitations: A userspace sysfs node name does not independently prove the physical controller vendor or model.
The Android source and archived kernel DTS appear inconsistent; branch, revision, alias, and stale-config explanations have not been distinguished.

claims.subject: Physical touchscreen controller identity
claims.finding: Not established. The ILITEK-family kernel binding and NVT-labelled Android gesture interface remain unreconciled.
limitations: Do not select a physical vendor or exact IC model from these source observations alone.

claims.subject: Exact LCD module SKU and revision
claims.finding: Not established by the available DTS label.
limitations: The panel configuration name is not a verified module part number.
